notes: Two taḥwīl routes, each with its own chain down to يزيد بن هرمز; the text then writes «كتب نجدة بن عامر إلى ابن عباس» once, so it is the shared tail
«كتب» is rule 5: the writer is a link, then the one written to; the saying is Ibn Abbas's written answer, so he is the last link
«واللفظ له» is an editor gloss; «فشهدت ابن عباس» is the witness's own account, not a link
